info.description: API untuk sistem rekrutmen Wowrack/Albyei Corp. Mendukung multi-role (Admin, HR, Hiring Manager, Candidate).
info.title: Wowrack Recruitment API

get.description: Get paginated list of all users (Admin/HR/Manager only)

post.description: Admin creates a new user (HR or Hiring Manager) and sends credentials via email

get.description: Get all roles assigned to a specific user

post.description: Assign a new role to a user (admin only)

delete.description: Remove a specific role from a user (admin only). Cannot remove the last role.

post.description: Authenticate user and get JWT token
Create a new candidate account with optional photo upload

get.description: Get all job applications submitted by the authenticated candidate

put.description: Edit a pending job application (name, phone, address, linkedin, optional new CV)

get.description: Get paginated list of jobs for Hiring Manager dashboard

post.description: Hiring Manager creates a new job posting in draft status

patch.description: Hiring Manager publishes an approved job posting
Hiring Manager submits a draft job for HR approval

get.description: Get list of all active (published) job vacancies for HR dashboard
Get a single active vacancy detail by its ID (HR only)
Get paginated list of all job applications (HR only)
Get a single application detail by its ID (HR only)

patch.description: Change the status of a job application (HR only)

get.description: Get list of all departments (HR only)
Get a single department by its ID (HR only)

put.description: Update an existing department name (HR only)

delete.description: Delete a department by ID (HR only)

get.description: Get paginated list of all jobs for HR dashboard
Get paginated list of applications for a specific job (HR only)

patch.description: HR approves a submitted job posting
HR closes a published job posting
HR rejects a submitted job posting with a reason

get.description: Get paginated list of news articles with optional filters (HR only)

post.description: Create a new news or culture article with image and optional gallery (HR only)

get.description: Get a single news/culture article by its ID (HR only)

put.description: Update an existing news article with optional new image/gallery (HR only)

delete.description: Permanently delete a news article and all associated photos (HR only)

get.description: Get all published job vacancies with optional filters and pagination
Get a single published job posting by its slug

post.description: Submit a job application with CV file upload (multipart/form-data)

delete.description: Permanently delete the authenticated user's account

get.description: Get the currently authenticated user's profile

put.description: Update the currently authenticated user's profile

Bearer.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
Bearer.name: Authorization
